resources.string: Trim, join, crop and compress ordinary library videos. Completion requires verification and library publication. Originals are retained.
Trim boundaries align inward to source frames. Each boundary may shorten by up to one frame interval. Actual boundaries are recorded; arbitrary microsecond accuracy is not guaranteed.
Limits: 8 segments; 30 minutes per source and output; at least 0.25 seconds per requested segment and 3 frames after alignment. Compatibility and output settings are checked again before processing.

The recording page provides proportional selection and private segment processing. Cropping here does not change the earlier system capture scope or guarantee region-exclusive capture. Vault is disabled.

Use a lower resolution and bitrate policy. Actual size depends on content, source and device. Smaller output is not guaranteed; no unmeasured size estimate is provided.
Limits: 2 GiB per source and output, 4 GiB across distinct sources; longest edge 1920 pixels, at most 1920 × 1080 pixels and 60 fps. Save-space mode limits the longest edge to 1280 pixels.
Only verified H.264, 8-bit SDR, constant-frame-rate video is supported. Segments must be compatible. Silent or matching AAC-LC tracks are checked; incompatible input stops processing.

Full-screen recording may include the current page, other apps and notifications. Switching apps or tabs changes the image. Hide sensitive content and confirm your right to record.

Advanced recording requests the full default display. Check the system consent scope; some devices may override the request. Dimensions cannot confirm app or content identity. Single-app regional capture is not guaranteed.
Choose the scope on the system consent page. Unverifiable scope is shown as unknown. A single app may be selected when supported. Hidden tabs and background pages are not guaranteed to be captured.

The full system capture briefly passes through memory/GPU. Only the confirmed region is encoded to private segments. No temporary full-screen file is saved and crop failure does not fall back to full-screen output.
Proportional selection defines coordinates only; it is not bound to an app, page or earlier screen. The later system-authorized frame is cropped to those coordinates. Check the consent scope.

Selection uses the full display including system bars. Dimension, rotation or inset changes safely stop capture and require new selection and consent. Control-bar exclusion has not been device-tested and is not guaranteed.

Only system-permitted internal playback audio is supported. The microphone is not used. Audio may include other capture-permitted apps; video scope does not guarantee matching audio scope. Source policy, silence or system restrictions may produce silent output.
Secure-window and protected-content restrictions are respected. Black or silent output does not establish DRM detection.

Recording uses a foreground service. Leaving this page does not stop an active session. Stop here or through its system notification. If notifications are unavailable, use the system active-apps control to end the service.

Configured frame rate is not a measured guarantee. Variable-frame-rate or incompatible segments may be unsupported by editing. Processing failures retain private segments for recovery and do not report success. Only supported, verified library output can be cropped, compressed or previewed.
